# Nexus v1.96.1 community release

This is an unofficial interim Nexus package from the `good-enough-nexus`
branch. It gives the Project Ebonhold community a usable build while Visceral
prepares the official Better-Nexus v1.20 release.

## Included

- Bounded community-build and DPS retention with compatibility migrations.
- Cached and incremental Builds and Leaderboard work for large saved libraries.
- Wishlist automation, Sync safety, diagnostics, and session performance data.
- The architecture refactors and behavior-preserving performance fixes tested on
  the `good-enough-nexus` branch.

## Support scope

This release has no routine hotpatch schedule. Maintenance is limited to issues
that block core addon functionality.

In-addon update notices continue to point to Visceral's official release page
so the package can hand users back to Better-Nexus v1.20 when it appears.

Back up `NexusDB` and `WishlistRealizerDB` before installing. Remove the old
`Interface\AddOns\Nexus` folder, then extract the archive so the final path is
`Interface\AddOns\Nexus\Nexus.toc`.

## Verify the download

The release includes a `.sha256` file and a JSON build manifest containing the
exact tag commit and Git tree. GitHub Actions also records a signed build
provenance attestation for the ZIP.

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Nexus-v1.96.1.zip -Algorithm SHA256
gh attestation verify .\Nexus-v1.96.1.zip -R SchmidtCode/Better-Nexus
```

Compare the PowerShell hash with `Nexus-v1.96.1.zip.sha256`.
